title: Post Turkey Links: St. Anthony's Surpasses 50 Million Meals Served
summary: Contra Costa County authorities say a 44-year-old Oakley man fatally shot his wife and critically injured his stepdaughter following a Thanksgiving argument; hackers have reportedly penetrated the Air Force’s cloud computing platform; and a watchdog report finds excessive spending at Guantanamo Bay.
content: Local: Contra Costa County authorities say a 44-year-old Oakley man fatally shot his wife and critically injured his 16-year-old stepdaughter following a Thanksgiving night argument. Two other young children in the home were found safe after the wounded teenager reportedly fled the premises with them. [ ABC7 ] At Berkeley perfumery Scents By the Bay, Tarah Ornelas is on a mission to re-create the specific, sentimental smells that populate her customers' memories. [ Chronicle ] This Thanksgiving, longtime St. Anthony's volunteer Diane Horowitz had the honor of serving the Tenderloin District organization's 50 millionth meal. [ KPIX ] National: Hackers of unknown origin have reportedly penetrated the Air Force’s cloud computing platform, per a US official. The hack risks exposure of sensitive military information and follows the hacking of the FBI's NCIC Database last week. [ NBC Bay Area ] A new watchdog report found that the U.S. Defense Department spent just over $81 million to transfer and hold migrants at Naval Station Guantanamo Bay in Cuba despite having held only 849 individuals since the operation began a year ago. [ CNN ] London police believe the release of an unknown substance during rapper Don Toliver's recent concert in Manchester, which sent fans to local hospitals with stinging eyes and burning throats, may be related to a string of attempted robberies. [ ABC7 ] Video: Now that Thanksgiving is in the rearview, the season of ice skating is upon us. Get in the spirit with footage of eager skaters hitting the rink at Union Square to kick off the 2026 holiday season, via NBC Bay Area :
